$comment: StudyGotchi SFX palette. Each sound is either a single ZzFX parameter array (`zzfx`) or a few `layers` mixed with a start offset `at` (seconds) and `gain`. Arrays are written out in full (21 params, ZzFX 1.3.x order) so agents can edit any slot. Units: frequency Hz; attack/sustain/release/delay seconds; slide = 500 Hz per second; deltaSlide = 500 Hz/s per second; pitchJump Hz after pitchJumpTime s; repeatTime s (also the tremolo period; keep tremolo <= 0.5 for one pulse per repeat); filter Hz, negative = low-pass (cutoff ~2x the value), positive = high-pass. Shapes: 0 sin, 1 triangle, 2 saw, 3 tan, 4 noise, 5 square. Toybox rules: sine/triangle only unless it is air (shape 4 + low-pass), volumes 0.2-0.75, pitches on C/D-major pentatonic notes, everything under ~1.1 s except ambience.

ui-tap.description: 40 ms sine blip on E5 with a hair of downward slide; the default tap for buttons and cards.

ui-confirm.description: Two-note upward mallet C5 -> G5, soft triangle; primary actions and saves.

ui-cancel.description: Low-passed triangle gliding down D5 -> G4; back, dismiss, close without saving.

ui-hover.description: Very quiet 40 ms tick on A5 for hover and focus changes; barely there.

card-open.description: Rounded swoop up G4 -> D5 that flattens at the top, like a card sliding open.

card-close.description: Mirror of card-open: swoop down D5 -> G4 with the same soft low-pass.

sprout-appear.description: Little sine 'bloop' rising A4 -> E5 and settling; a sprout or new node pops up.

landmark-build-1.description: Stage 1 build: two soft wooden knocks on G3 (repeat + tremolo), low-passed.

landmark-build-2.description: Stage 2 build: four brighter knocks on C4, same wood but more of it.

landmark-build-3.description: Stage 3 build: five knocks climbing D4 -> G4 with a short hall echo; the big one.

landmark-upgrade.description: Four-note D-major arpeggio A4 D5 F#5 A5 on a soft mallet with a light echo.

creature-arrive.description: Pop + sparkle: a descending sine 'bwop' followed by a rising high sine arpeggio with echo.

creature-tap.description: Squishy triangle 'boing' E4 up to ~B4 and back down; poking the creature.

creature-happy.description: Two cheerful rising chirps D5->A5, G5->B5 (repeat + pitch jump), pure sine.

creature-sad.description: Drooping 'awww': A4 sliding down with a drop to D4, low-passed and quiet.

creature-sleep.description: Soft two-tone sigh C4 -> G3 with a slow attack and long release; the sleep bubble.

creature-greet.description: Pikmin-ish 'brrp?': low-passed triangle rising G4 -> ~E5 with an 18 Hz gargle.

evidence-ingested.description: Slurp + ding: a rising low-passed sweep E4 -> ~B5, then a C6 bell with echo.

progress-tick.description: Tiny coin tick C6 -> E6, 120 ms; one per progress increment.

progress-streak.description: Coin-like B5 -> E6 with a short echo; streak kept.

progress-level-up.description: Rising D-major run A4 D5 F#5 A5 ... F#6 on a soft mallet with echo; level or stage complete.

camera-dive.description: Descending sine sweep G5 -> A3 under a soft low-passed air swell; zooming into a world.

camera-rise.description: Mirror of camera-dive: sine sweep C4 -> G5 with the same air swell; pulling back out.

visit-whoosh.description: One-second airy whoosh (low-passed noise swell) with a sparkle arpeggio tail; visiting a friend's world.

space-enter.description: Into the sky: a low-passed air swell that lifts, a slow sine climb from C5 that flattens near the top, then a G6 sparkle arpeggio with echo; the zoom-out into the Information sky.

star-select.description: Small two-note bell E6 -> B6, pure sine with a short echo; a star picked in the sky.

lens-weak.description: Low, soft triangle sinking A4 -> ~D4 with a slow attack and low-pass; the Weak Areas lens coming on.

cluster-glide.description: Short sine glide G5 -> ~D6 that eases into its landing; the camera flying to a cluster label.

error-soft.description: Wobbly low 'mmp' on A3 (18 Hz tremolo), low-passed; a gentle no.

explode-comic.description: Cartoon poof: deep soft thump + low-passed noise puff + a descending 'bwoop' blorp. Comic, not violent.

recover-chime.description: Bounce back: triangle slide up E4 -> E5, then a C6 E6 G6 C7 sparkle with echo.

ambient-wind-gust.description: 2 s low-passed noise swell that rises then settles; a wind gust for outdoor biomes.

ambient-bird-chirp.description: Three quick sine chirps stepping down (~2.1k, 1.85k, 1.6k Hz), each rising; quiet.
